method.exposure: Exact supporting facets, rounded outward by 2 cm. Hull-plane separation with a 10 nm numerical guard removes potentially occluded points. A zero count is unresolved.
method.samples: Nearest Euclidean distance to each source triangle set independently. The two largest per source have exact exposed lower certificates. Samples do not certify a maximum.
method.upper: Exact dyadic fan checks, fixed-point patch/triangle witnesses and outward-rounded geometric budgets cover even unsampled edge/vertex offsets and occluded piece surfaces.
method.mandatoryVertices: Exact point-triangle threshold checks against every opposite-source triangle. These bound occupied source points, independent of exposed-boundary sampling.
